text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I heard Fuji Kiseki's
voice coming from the dance studio...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...One! Two! Three!

Fuji Kiseki seems focused on dancing.
I should hold off on calling out to her until she's done.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Seven! ——Eight!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Maybe the last part needs a little more...
choice_data_list: Good work! You're really trying your best.
Good work! You're really giving it your all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. You were watching.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. If you were watching, would you mind
giving me your thoughts on it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what I want to know is whether you're aiming
to push your limits, or to play a tranquil harmony,
but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply: you can either dazzle them
with an intense dance, or deliver a harmonious
blend of song and dance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Both of them have their own merits,
so I just can't choose...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The ultimate dance, or a harmonized
performance?
Which do you think one should choose?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Anyone would want to see
something they've never seen before, after all...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, they do say that those called great actors
should possess an extraordinary radiance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thanks. That cleared my head.
I'll show you the greatest dance ever.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For that sake—for now, just faster, higher, sharper!
I only need to reach for my own limits!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!

Fuji Kiseki showed off sharpness surpassing even
professional dancers. Her moves were truly
at the top level of the academy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, makes sense. If you're going to watch anyway,
you'd want to see perfection, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright. In that case, I must finish everything to perfection.
For true harmony allows not even the slightest flaw, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...And above all else, I wouldn't want
to see the disappointed faces of my little ponies♪"

Fuji Kiseki perfects every single minor gesture.
It is the accumulation of those details that sharpens
her performance to sheer perfection.
